title: Alex's vanilla
description: Optimized vanilla experience with a few extras
body:
Alex’s vanilla is designed to enhance the core Minecraft experience without straying from its original atmosphere. Rather than completely overhauling the game, it aims to provide a “vanilla”-friendly, balanced, and refined gameplay experience through subtle improvements.

✨ Features
- 🌿 Vanilla friendly desing - Every mod stays true to Minecraft's original style
- ⚙️ Quality-of-life improvements - A smoother, more comfortable gaming experience
- 🚀 Performance optimizations - Better FPS and overall stability
- 🎨 Subtle visual enhancements - Improved graphics while preserving the "vanilla" aesthetic
